term: natural light of human reason (shared sense)
definition: `P.AnswersToSharedReason m`: the correctness of m answers to standards of reason shared with those outside the practice, available without the practice's revelation or authority. This is the sense in which STMT-NATURAL-REASON-IS-SHARED-REASON reads Dei Filius's 'naturali humanae rationis lumine', set against revelation 'alia, eaque supernaturali via'.
note: Stipulated reading of the council's phrase; the text supports it by the contrast with the supernatural way but does not define the phrase. DISAMB-NATURAL-REASON records the rival practice-internal sense.
